nullPolicies.required: SQL NOT NULL; JSON presence still checked by reader/key metadata.

ownershipPrecedence.rule: Historical atlas holder/control/status never supplies current assignments, including as fallback. Current region-content read with cia-current-rights successor overlay takes precedence. Preserve atlas geometry/source edition independently.
